title: SE Ops Clinic: customer runway & triage digest — 2026-05-19
agenda:
1) Quick status roll (top 5 customers)
2) Blockers & escalation decisions
3) Capacity + Dedicated pool runway
4) Short-term mitigations (tech/deploy)
5) Action allocation and owners
content:
Summary:
This is the SE + ProServices weekly triage focused on customer runway and unresolved blockers. Notes are intentionally terse; action items pulled out separately. Tone: operational — prioritize unblock -> deploy -> communicate.

Highlights and customer-level notes:
- Veridian (Private deployment): TLS handshake failures between customer HSM and our agent during key import. Root cause: HSM requires RSA-4096 with specific OID extension absent from our agent TLS stack. Marco to own patch with infra; proposed hotfix in agent 1.32.1. Risk: blocked for scheduled UAT on 2026-05-23. Escalation: contact Veridian security lead and schedule parallel handoff call. (JIRA: SE-3421)

- OrchidAnalytics (Hosted + Dedicated hybrid): Observed 95th-99th percentile latency spikes during long-context queries (seq 6k+). Investigation points to KV cache eviction thrash when multiple concurrent long-context requests touch different prefixes. Short mitigation: increase prefix cache TTL and pin most-used prefixes for Orchid for 48hrs. Medium-term: PR 812 adds smarter eviction heuristics (LRU by customer-weight + prefix frequency). Claire to track PR merge and rollout.

- Tidewater (Dedicated): Daily batch jobs causing transient GPU memory pressure in east-2a pool leading to preemption and retry storms. SRE suggests enabling burst capacity policy for scheduled windows (02:00-06:00 UTC) and bumping the reserved commit by 10% for the next quarter. Samir will run a cost/benefit analysis; include finance snapshot. (JIRA: OPS-1187)

- Mosaic Beta (Hosted API): Rangy output regressions after quantized 4-bit rollout; quality alerts tripped for reranking model. Decision: rollback to q8 variant while we instrument failing prompts. Eva to coordinate with Applied ML for root-cause and create an eval set slice.

Operational items discussed:
- Canary rollout tuning: current canary window set to 1% for all new models. Decision to pilot 3% canary for non-critical customers to collect broader telemetry; Jonah to draft rollout policy update (risk thresholds and automatic fallback).
- Routing policy fallback: Add an explicit fallback model variant mapping for customers with strict latency SLOs (Veridian, Orchid, Tidewater). Action: add mapping to deployment manifest templates.
- Observability gap: token-level cost attribution for Dedicated pools is noisy when autoscaling occurs. Follow-up: SRE + Console team to add a smoothing window to per-route cost calculation (Priya + Console PM).

Parking lot / backlog notes:
- Improve HSM handshake test coverage in CI (postmortem ticket to be created).
- Runbook update for KV cache eviction tuning per-customer.
- Explore an emergency small instance pool for <1hr warmups during migrations.

Decisions made:
- Veridian: pursue agent hotfix and schedule emergency handoff call; do not postpone UAT yet but communicate risk window.
- Orchid: apply prefix pinning + push PR 812 to staging; monitor latency for 48 hours.
- Tidewater: authorize temporary burst capacity pending Samir's cost sheet.

Action items (owners and due dates):

Claire Nguyen - monitor PR 812, merge to staging and run smoke tests for Orchid - due 2026-05-22
Samir Banerjee - cost/benefit for Dedicated pool bump and burst policy, include finance numbers - due 2026-05-24
Eva Morales - rollback q4->q8 for Mosaic Beta and produce eval slice for regressions - due 2026-05-20
Jonah Lee (Product) - draft updated canary rollout policy (3% pilot) and fallback thresholds - due 2026-05-26
Priya Shah (SRE) + Console PM - propose smoothing window approach for cost attribution - due 2026-05-28
Aisha Patel - write postmortem ticket for HSM CI coverage and link to SE-3421 - due 2026-05-21
decisions: Hotfix agent 1.32.1 for Veridian HSM handshake is approved
Apply prefix pinning and merge PR 812 for Orchid latency mitigation
Authorize temporary Dedicated pool burst for Tidewater until end of quarter pending cost analysis
notes_footers: Quick comms: please update linked JIRA tickets when actions start. If you hit a blocker, call the on-call lead and post an update in #se-triage. This doc is intentionally short-form; full writeups will live on Confluence pages linked above.
